limits: Reference configuration only; no deformed-arm acceptance.
Source containment uses odd/even floating-point ray queries at positive quadrature locations, not an exact set-volume difference.
Lateral boundary samples exclude authored cut caps; positive signed values mean outside source.
Longitudinal thirds localize authored belly approximation, not measured muscle-tendon junctions.
Transverse surface crossings omit coplanar/grazing contacts; quadrature bone containment is sampled.
Original full source surfaces are checked separately; source-versus-belly regions differ, so crossing counts are not an error norm.
Detected source outside depth and bone intrusion are uncorrected geometry defects, not thresholds to relax.
